id: Once Upon a Time in Mexico (2003)

facts.text: Best pork in the country, no question. If it isn't, somebody is about to have a bad day.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Sands's words, but it is not a line from the film. Sands does love puerco pibil, so a signed note in his voice suits. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: Best pork in Mexico, they tell me. It had better be. Another plate, please.

fix_note.text: Best pork in Mexico, they tell me. It had better be. Another plate, please.

vibe.verdict: The pibil stand is the right idea for Sands, and the Day of the Dead and mole are good, but the film's other characters are missing.
missing: Sands losing his eyes and still shooting a hitman with a chicle boy's help
El Mariachi's guitar case of weapons
Billy Chambers and his chihuahua with the hidden microphone
Barillo's body double in the hospital
Lorenzo and Fideo walking off with the cash
The coup at the presidential palace on Day of the Dead
ideas: Swap 'Sopes with refried beans and queso' for 'Chicle boy chewing gum sweets' tied to the boy who helps Sands.
Swap 'Chicken in red mole with rice' note for 'Barillo's body double dinner'.
Swap 'Mexican chocolate flan' for 'Chambers' chihuahua flan' with a note about the hidden microphone.
Swap the 'Order slip' line 'Extra salsa, no questions' for 'Extra salsa, ask the chicle boy'.
